sloka: तथा सञ्चोदितः सूतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना ।तद्वाक्यमृषिणा प्रोक्तं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.५१.१ ॥
transliteration: tathā sañcoditaḥ sūto lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā ।tadvākyamṛṣiṇā proktaṁ vyāhartumupacakrame ।। 7.51.1 ॥

translations.english: Thus urged by the great-souled Lakshmana, the charioteer began to narrate the words spoken by the sage.
